optional.public_research: Host supplies dated source artifacts and access limitations; no built-in retrieval.
optional.image_generation: Host returns generated PNG, dimensions, hash, exact lens, alt and full text equivalent; no fabricated native API.
optional.image_inspection: Host inspects actual raster and records factual/visual QA before report completion.
optional.browser_visual_qa: Host records supported-browser wide/narrow, keyboard and image inspection; static checks do not satisfy.
optional.human_confirmation: Original engine confirmation/authorization gates remain separate from report storage.
optional.scheduler: Unactivated portable intent only; host must obtain and verify user-selected schedule and destination.
optional.private_delivery: Host verifies recipient access and retention; no automatic upload.

probe_rule: A declaration is not availability. portable.py doctor reports only capabilities it actually observed.
external_effects: No network, model calls, trading, credential handling, scheduler activation or native registration implemented.
